title: Now Is the Day of Grace
description: Now Is the Day of Grace in Tonic Solfa to AYLESBURY, doh is Ab: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 265 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “Now is the Day of Grace”, where the book credits them to the Select Hymns.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Short Metre (6.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to AYLESBURY; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Now is the day of grace; Now to the Fa-ther come; The Lord is call-ing, "Seek my face, And I will guide you home."

lines: Now is the day of grace;
The Lord is calling, "Seek my face,
And I will guide you home."
He calls in love; he sees your need;
Then, O, be wise; to-morrow's sun

licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1853.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to AYLESBURY by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
